div.div:
Design boundaries
Local playback survives network failure. PostgreSQL owns job state; Redis carries notifications.
Beat triggers worker recovery; provider credentials stay on the server.
Planned: authenticated ownership, pre-upload disclosure and protected media (Section 8.5).
